headline: Ukrainian Drones Strike Russian Nizhnekamskneftekhim Plant and Power Grid
summary: Long-range strike drones struck the Nizhnekamskneftekhim petrochemical facility in Russia's Tatarstan and a 220 kV substation powering the TAGMET metallurgical plant in Rostov, causing industrial damage and fires.
why: Targeting of downstream refining and petrochemical assets threatens Russian industrial output and synthetic material supplies.

impacts.name: Russian Petrochemicals
impacts.why: Drone hits on the Nizhnekamskneftekhim complex disrupt domestic petrochemical and rubber manufacturing operations.
